item.title: Process as a Proxy for Motivation
item.description:
📝 In time, I made a decision - I would take the route which went north out of Glasgow. Deciding to always take the northbound route did not mean that I would get there any faster, it did not mean that I would enjoy the trip more, it did not have any benefit related to the journey itself. It did, however, mean that I would not need to make a decision when I got to Glasgow, I would just have a rule which I had to follow.
🔗 Read more: https://bengodfrey.dev/blog/process/
